tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba yang dag zla gam gcig pa dang dgu pa'i bsnyen sgrub sbyin sreg dang bcas pa'i yi ge badzra he ru ka'i zhal lung bzhugs so// bla ma dpal chen po yang dag thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ gu ru shrī ma hā saṃmyag tsitta ya na maḥ yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi ye shes thugs/ /thugs kyi bdag nyid badzra he ru ka /ka dag dbyings las khro chags nyams ldan sku/ /sku gsum bdag nyid bla ma khro chen rgyal/ /rgyal ba'i thugs bcud mkhas dang grub las brgyud/ /brgyud pa ji bzhin 'khon rog thugs dam mdzad/ /mdzad pas grub gnyis mthar son man ngag 'di/ /'di ltar bsnyen pa'i lag len bshad kyis nyon/ /de la 'dir dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i rgyud 'dir rigs lnga phyogs gcig tu sgrub pa rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor zla gam lnga bcu rtsa brgyad pa dang / rigs so sor sgrub pa la rigs drug gi dkyil 'khor 'byung yang / da lta yongs su grags pa mi bskyod pa'i rigs gtso bor gyur pa yang dag zla gam dgu pa dang / de las kyang bskyed pa'i rim pa cha dbri nas rdzogs pa chen po'i man ngag nyams su len pa'i phyir yang dag mar me gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams gsungs pa las/ dpal he ru ka zla gam gcig pa'i sgrub thabs kyi rtsa ba slob dpon hūm̐ ka ras mdzad pa dang / gan pa rin rgyal gyis mdzad pa gzhir bzhag nas/ cung zad mi gsal ba rnams gsal bar byas shing / cho ga'i chings dang / lha'i bskyed tshul sogs yi ge rnying pa rnams su mi 'dra ba du ma 'byung yang / rdo rje phur pa'i mngon rtogs chos rje bla ma dam pas mdzad pa rnams dang bstun nas nyams su blang bde bar bgyis te rgyun du nyams su len pa dang / dus dang grangs kyi bsnyen pa byed pa'i tshe sgrub thabs chung ba 'di nyid don tshang bas/ thog mar gang du bsnyen pa bya ba'i sa phyogs dben zhing nyams dga' ba'i sgrub khang bla ma gong ma yid ches pa rnams kyi bzhugs gnas yin pa'am/

yang na 'dre srin gdug pa can gnas pa'i sa ma yin par/ rang gi mdun du bla ma yi dam gyi rten gang rigs dang / khyad par dpal chen yang dag gi sku lugs ma'am/ bris sku rab gnas can gyi mdun du 'di'i gtor ma stod zur gsum/ smad zlum po mtheb kyus bskor ba la/ ched du bsad pa ma yin pa'i sha khrag gis brgyan pa dbus su bzhag de'i g.yon du bhandha lcang lo can gyi nang du rakta/ gtor ma'i g.yas su thod pa mtshan ldan gyi nang du sman phud gtsang ma/ thun gsum ka'i rjes la bsngo ba'i dkar mo'i zlum gtor/ bdud rgyal dang phur srung gi zur gsum dang / dgong thun la gtor bsngo chen mo byed na dam rdzas gcig nas bcu'i bar grangs rgyas bsdus phyag len bzhin dang / de rnams kyi mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod bshams/ mar ngo'i brgyad dam bcu'am bcu bzhi gang rung la gza' skar drag cing shis pa'i dgong kha'i dus sgrub khang gi phyi rol tu gzhan bsrung ba'i mtshams tho mngon mtshan can 'dzugs pa 'di la bla ma gong ma'i phyag len rgyas bsdus sna tshogs 'dug kyang / sa lo yab sras rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa ni/ bgegs bskrad brtan bzhugs shis brjod tsam las gzhan mi mdzad pas de tsam gyis kyang go chod do/ /mtshams g.yog gnyis gsum dang lha rje/ phyogs kyi yi ge dngos po'i rigs mi 'jug ka med rnams dmigs khongs su chug par byas la gzhan zla gcig ring rgyu 'grul bcad de mtshams shin tu dam ngos/ rang nyid shar ram lhor kha phyogs pas stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ thog mar rdo rje'i rtses mchod rdzas rnams la nang mchod 'thor tshul dang / oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las bandha 'bar ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/

mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa'i spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ badzra a ha ra li hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra puṣpe hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dye/ oṃ badzra shapta hūm̐/ oṃ badzra u da pa la hūm̐/ oṃ badzra bi pu ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra dharma ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba buddha kṣe tra/ pra tsa li ni/ pra dzñā pā ra mi tā/ nā da swa bhā we na badzra dharma hrīḥd ya ni santo ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swāhā/ lan gsum ḍā dril dang bcas pas byin dbab/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dpal chen yab yum bzhugs pa'i sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs bla ma sangs rgyas kun 'dus su mos drung bdag dang sems can thams cad 'khod nas 'jigs dad snying rje gsum gyis kun nas blangs te byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro ba'i bsam pas/ ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/

/dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum brten pa'i zhing gyur la/ /gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs/ /nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ /ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang / /dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la/ /dgos pa gsum gyis lus 'bul lo/ /tshe rabs bgrangs ba'i las rnams kun/ /bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ /zhes skyabs yul rnams kyi spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa dang sems bskyed byas nas/ skyabs yul gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros te skyabs su 'gro ba rnams kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sku gnyis kyi sangs rgyas su gyur nas so so'i zhing du gshegs/ skyabs yul 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam/ tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni/ sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal dag dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing / /chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog /oṃ ma hā shu n+yā tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ phyi nang snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang skad cig gis dpal he ru ka zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ yum khro mo dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ badzra añdza li hūm̐/ badzra bandha/ badzra añdza li dza/ yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas khro bo mtshon cha thogs pa mang po byung ste/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad/ phaṭa/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ /song shig lha min lha yang rung / /nga la bar chad byed pa'i bdud/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par byos/ /oṃ badzra kro dha hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐ gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ badzra kro dha bi dza ya hūm̐ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha nī la daṇḍa hūm̐ da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha ya mānta ka hūm̐ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha ārya a tsa la hūm̐ bandha bandha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha ha ya gṛ wa hūm̐ hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha a pa rā dzi ta hūm̐ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li hūm̐ tshindha tshindha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha trai lo kya bi dzā ya hūm̐ bhindha bhindha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha ma hā ba la hūm̐ spho ṭa spho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ khro bo rnams rang gi thugs kar thim/ yang rang gi thugs ka nas mtshon cha rnam pa sna tshogs byung ste sna bug nas thon/ g.yas nas bskor bas bgegs bskrad de rwa bar gyur/ hūm̐ nga'i dkyil 'khor brtan bya'i phyir/ /khro rgyal byin rlabs las byung ba'i/ /mtshon cha rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /dkyil 'khor rim pa tshul bzhin srungs/ /oṃ badzra a yu dha rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang rdo rje khu tshur gnyis rgyab sbyar mthe'u chung gnyis sbrel gung mdzub brkyangs pa'i phyag rgya bcas/ yang g.yon nas bskor te mtshon cha'i gur du gyur nas bgegs kyis mi tshugs par bsam la/ sngar gyi phyag rgya dang sngags la phaṭa bzhag pa brjod/ de nas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo shin tu brtan zhing gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje thal mo sbyar ba las mtheb 'dzub gnyis rtse sprad pa rin po che'i rnam par byas pa dang / srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas/ /dmyal ba'i sa gzhi yan chad kyi/ /log par lta ba'i dgra dang bgegs/ /'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs/ /oṃ badzra te dza tiṣṭha tsakra rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang / g.yon bskor dang sngags la phaṭa bzhag pa gong bzhin/ rwa ba de dag las 'phros pa'i me 'od kyis bgegs thams cad bsregs par bsam zhing / thal mo rgyab sbyar ba'i sor mo gzhan rnams bsnol/ mthe bong rtse sprad pa dang /

phyi rol kun tu 'od 'phros pas/ /bdud dpung nges par sreg byed pa/ /sa dang mkha' kun khyab pa yi/ /'bar ba me yi phung por gyur/ /oṃ badzra dzwa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor bla ma dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma dang bcas pa srung 'khor gyi nang mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ ma maḥshrī he ru ka maṇḍa la sa pā ri wa re bhyaḥ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pa lan gsum gyis rgyun bshags bya/ mdun gyi tshogs kyi zhing de dag thams cad dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs bsdus nas bdag dang dkyil 'khor gyi gnas su thim pas byin gyis brlab par gyur/ a la la hoḥhūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ tas bsangs/ rang gi thugs ka nas raṃ dmar po spros pas mes bdud rtsi dang gtor ma'i snod la reg pas mi gtsang ba bsregs/ yaṃ spros pas rlung gis gtor/ khaṃ spros pas chus bkrus te skyon thams cad dag par byas/ bhrūṃ spros pas bandha 'bar ba'i snod chen por gyur/ oṃ spros pas 'dod pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang bar gyur/

oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung / raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs par hūm̐ oṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā las sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga'i ngo bor gyur/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ rdzas rnams 'od du zhu ba'i rlangs pa hūm̐ oṃ swāhā ā las phyag mtshan lngar gyur/ hūm̐ badzra dhrika oṃ dzi na dzika swā ratna dhṛka ā a ro l̥ka hā pra dzñā dhṛka he ru ka yab yum bcur gyur/ sa ma ya hoḥsbyor ba'i me'i 'od du zhu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ du gyur/ de las 'od 'phros pas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bdud rtsi bkug nas thim/ 'og gi bdud rtsi gtor ma dang 'dres pas kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥtha/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ te dzo ba liṃ ta ba la bā te gu hya siddhi sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥtha/ zhes bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rakta'i snod a las thod pa yangs par/ ra las dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ ma sūrya maṇḍa la spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍal hūm̐ hrīḥtha/ zhes bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ dang po rang gi sems ma bcos pa stong pa nyid spros pa dang bral ba chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin dang / stong pa nyid des 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la khyab cing / de ltar ma rtogs pa rnams la rab tu brtse ba'i snying rje bsgom pa kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / thabs shes rab gnyis med rang rig gsal la ma 'gags pa de yi ge hūm̐ sngon po gcig tu gyur pa rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin te/

oṃ ma hā shu n+yā tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ hūm̐ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ hūm̐ las raṃ chad snod bcud kyi 'jig rten bsregs/ yaṃ spros pas rlung gis gtor/ khaṃ spros pas chus bkrus/ skyon thams cad dag par byas/ e yaṃ baṃ raṃ laṃ raṃ keṃ bhrūṃ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ hūm̐ las yi ge de dag spros pas rten gyi dkyil 'khor du gyur/ e las mkha' dbyings dag pa'i nam mkha'i dkyil/ /yaṃ las rlung chen rgya gram sra zhing brtan/ /de steng baṃ las byung ba'i chu dkyil dkar/ /raṃ las me byung spyod pa de yi phyed/ /laṃ las sa yi dkyil 'khor brtan par gyur/ /de steng rakta'i rgya mtsho rba rlabs 'khrugs/ /dbus su keng rus ri rab brtsegs pa'i steng / /bde chen byang chub sems nyid gzhal yas khang / /dkar dmar mdog can zla gaṃ sgo gcig pa/ /dzaḥpaṃ padma maṇḍal/ ma sūrya maṇḍa la/ a tsand+rā maṇḍal/ ma hā dee wa dzaḥ u ma de wī dzaḥ padma nyi ma zla ba drag po pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan gyi steng du rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi hūm̐ de babs pa las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus/ 'od du zhu bas rang dpal chen yang dag gi skur gyur pa ni hūm̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyoḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ dbus su bdag nyid khro bo'i rgyal/ /bcom ldan rdo rje he ru ka /mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal/ /rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ rnga chung g.yas/ /dril bu thod khrag rgyu zhags g.yon/ /rdo rje khyung gshog rab tu gdengs/ /mche gtsigs spyan gsum zlum zhing dmar/ /ral pa kham pa gyen du brdzes/ /glang lpags zhing chen g.yang gzhi gsol/ /stag gi pags pa'i 'og lpags can/ /dkar dmar ljang nag sbrul gyis brgyan/ /dbu rgyan se ral sked bcings dang / /phyag dang zhabs rnams rnam par spras/ /thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/

/rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ /rakta zhag dang thal chen gyi/ /thig le zo ris tshom bur byas/ /sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /zhabs bzhi g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs nas/ /dbang phyug kha bub mgo bo dang / /dbu ma'i nu mar rab brdzis shing / /ye shes me phung dbus na bzhugs/ /oṃ badzra kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐/ yum chen khro mo dbang phyug sngo/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje/ /g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stobs/ /gzig gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ /rus pa'i rgyan lngas sku la spras/ /thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ /skam po lnga bcus do shal byas/ /sbrul dang rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan/ /rakta zhag dang thal chen gis/ /thig le zo ris tshom bur byas/ /zhabs gnyis g.yas g.yon brkyang bskum gyis/ /yab kyi g.yon nas 'khyud pas bzhugs/ /rang lus rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du gsal ba ni/ byang khog chos kyi 'byung gnas/ nang gi dbugs ni rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ lus kyi drod me/ chu ser dang sha lpags chu dang sa/ rtsa sbub kyi khrag rakta'i rgya mtsho/ sgal tshigs keng rus kyi ri rab/ lus 'dom gang gru bzhi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ snying kha nas 'byung ba bzhi yi rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa ba'i bu ga bzhi ni sgo bzhi/ tsitta gzhal yas khang zla gam/ srog rtsa sgo gcig pa/ snying tshil dkar dmar nyi zla'i gdan/ dbang po lnga mchod pa'i lha mo ste rten gyi dkyil 'khor dang / spyi gtsug tu badzra he ru ka sngon po g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ 'tshogs mar buddha he ru ka dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon des༞ rna ba g.yas par ratna he ru ka ser po g.yas rin po che/ g.yon des yu ba༞ ltag par padma he ru ka dmar po g.yas padma༞ g.yon des༞ rna ba g.yon par karma he ru ka ljang gu g.yas rdo rje rgya gram/ g.yon des༞ dpral bar sku rdo rje dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon des༞

mgrin par gsung rdo rje dmar po g.yas padma/ g.yon des༞ thugs kar thugs rdo rje sngon po g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang rang 'od kyi rig ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas la gau rī/ g.yon la pra mo ha/ phyag g.yas dang po tsau rī/ g.yon dang po betta lī/ g.yas bar pa pukka sī/ tha ma shma sha nī/ g.yon bar pa ghasma rī/ tha ma tsaṇḍa lī/ sgal tshigs dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ snying kha'i dbus su ye shes sems dpa' rang 'dra tshon gang ba'i thugs kar rin po che zur brgyad pa'i lte bar rdo rje nas 'bras tsam gyi lte ba la/ nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ yungs 'bru tsam gyi mthar ru lu skra shad kyis bris pa lta bus bskor ba/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha khro bo rigs lnga badzra sa mā dzaḥ thabs kyi spyod pas sems can don/ /byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba/ /sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs par mdzod/ /dbang dang byin rlabs 'dir stsol cig /ces gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis ye shes kyi chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor he ru ka rigs lnga yab yum gyis dbu brgyan par bsam zhing / oṃ badzra shrī he ru ka badzra kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐/ oṃ buddha shrī he ru ka buddha kro dhī shwa rī oṃ/ oṃ ratna shrī he ru ka ratna kro dhī shwa rī trāṃ/ oṃ padma shrī he ru ka padma kro dhī shwa rī hrīḥ oṃ karma shrī he ru ka karma kro dhī shwa ri ā/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas dpal chen yang dag lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la dam can srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes dang / rdo rje g.yab/ sngags kyi tshe dril bu gsil zhing / hūm̐ bcom ldan dpal chen khro rgyal yab yum dang / /sprul pa yang sprul bka' sdod srung ma'i tshogs/ /glog ltar myur ba'i thugs rjes 'dir gshegs nas/ /ye shes thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ badzra shrī he ru ka maṇḍa la sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i thal mo gan rkyal dang / sngags kyi tshe dril bu gsil zhing / gsal la mi 'gyur chos kyi sku/ /bsam med chos dbyings nam mkha' 'dra/ /brjod med rnam shes gzugs dang bral/ /'du 'bral med pa mkha' la rdzogs/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa mahā su kha hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ rdo rje phyag 'tshal ba'i stangs ka dang sngags kyi tshe dril bu gsil zhing / rtog med spros bral mkha' dbyings dag /skye med rdo rje sku gsung thugs/ /rang byung bcom ldan thugs rje'i lha/ /'du 'bral med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /a ti pu ho/ pra ti dza hoḥ 'o na sngags 'chang chen pos rim pa gsal ba las/ bdag bskyed kyi spyan 'dren la brtan bzhugs dang phyag 'tshal gsung gis/ mdun bskyed la ma gsung pas 'dir lhag go /zhe na ma yin te/ mdun bskyed la de dag sbyar na rgyas par 'gyur la/ ma sbyar na bsdus par 'gyur bas rgyas bsdus gang byed 'dam ka yin pas so/ /mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ bdag gi snying kha nas sprul pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis bdag dang mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la mchod par bsam zhing / sgeg phreng glu gar bdug pa me tog ma/ /mar me dri chab nyer spyod rol mo'i sgra/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten nam mkha'i khams bkang nas/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor dam can srung ma la/ /rnam dag blo yis mos blos bdag 'bul na/ /bzhes shig bla med sgrub mchog stsal du gsol/ /oṃ badzra lā sya hūm̐/ oṃ badzra mā le trāṃ/ oṃ badzra gīrti hrīḥ

oṃ badzra nīrta ā/ badzra dhū pe hūm̐/ badzra puṣpe trāṃ/ badzra ā lo ke hrīḥ badzra gandhe ā/ badzra puṣpe hūm̐/ badzra dhū pe hūm̐/ badzra ā lo ke hūm̐/ badzra gandhe hūm̐/ badzra nai wi dye hūm̐/ badzra shapta hūm̐/ sman mchod ni/ rang byung gdod nas dag pa yi/ /rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman/ /rigs lnga'i dam tshig lnga yi dngos/ /ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas/ /rgyud lnga sems can kun grol zhing / /dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di/ /ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po/ /thugs dam dbyings nas bskul ba'i phyir/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras bcas la/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ngang nyid du/ /bdag cag dad pas 'bul lags na/ /bzhes te kun tu dges mdzod la/ /'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta shrī ka pā la bandha ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rgyal ba kun dngos rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / /rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dang / /dpal chen he ru ka dpal yab yum la/ /rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rje cher dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gau rī tsau rī pra mo baitta lī/ /sbos mo za phod dur khrod gtum mo la/ /rnam dag༞ /thugs rje༞ /ma hā༞ phyi nang mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thams cad dang / /ging chen bco brgyad ging phran 'bum sde dang / /dpag bsam shing lha re ma ti rnams la/ /rnam dag༞༞༞ shwa na mu kha bdag nyid chen mo dang / /bse yi lha mo phyogs bcu'i rnal 'byor tshogs/ /dam srung mched lcam bstan ma bcu gnyis la/ /rnam dag༞༞༞ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du khā hi/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal༞ /chos sku kun tu bzang po'i༞ /longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'i༞ /sprul sku padma 'byung gnas༞ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi༞ /khyad par chos skyong srung ma'i zhal du khā hi/

rang gi lce la nang mchod bzhag nas/ byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i/ /rig 'dzin bdag cag thams cad la/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ /kā ya siddhi oṃ/ wā ka siddhi āḥ tsitta siddhi hūm̐/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ rtog med spros bral mkha' dbyings dag /skye med sku gsung thugs mnga' ba/ /rang byung bcom ldan thugs rje'i lha/ /zhi khro rab 'byams 'khor dang bcas/ /stong nyid dbyings nas thugs dam bskul/ /sprul pa'i dbyings nas gshegs su gsol/ /dngos po'i mtshan mar bzung du med/ /rtog bral yid kyi mchod pa 'di/ /dgongs pa zab mo'i thugs dam bskang / /chos sku'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka a mṛ ta sarba pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ḍā dril dang bcas/ gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma dang / /'dod pa'i yon tan rnam lnga po/ /chos dbyings skye ba med pa'i ngang / /ji ltar dmigs pa bzhin du 'bul/ /oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka ma hā ba liṃ ta pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rakta'i mchod pa ni/ rakta dmar gyi ārghaṃ 'di/ /dam rdzas khrag chen chags pa yi/ /ma bcos dbyings su dag bya'i phyir/ /dpal chen khrag 'thung zhal du 'bul/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka kro dhī shwa rī satwaṃ/ ma hā rakta pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pas dbul/ rdo rje phyag 'tshal ba'i stangs kas dang / dril bu shlau ka re'i mtshams su gsil la/ bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ bde gshegs mnyam nyid chos kyi ngang / /ma skyes rdo rje kun tu bzang / /thabs mkhas khro rgyal skur ston pa/ /he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam dag sku la chags mi mnga'/ /dgyes mdzad dpal chen sku la 'khril/ /shes rab gnyis med bde chen rdzogs/ /khro mo dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal/ /me long mnyam nyid so sor rtog /bya grub ye shes rang bzhin dang / /'byung bzhi rnam par dag pa yi/

/lha mo rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal chen 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol/ /khams gsum chos nyid dur khrod la/ /nyon mongs dug gsum thams cad ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor lo/ /tsitta mkha' mnyam rgyal po ni/ /kun gzhi ma bcos thig le la/ /rang byung ye shes sems dpa' bzhugs/ /dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med/ /de nas zla gam dgu pa dang / /ye shes me dgu gcig tu gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa/ /'bras bu sku gsung thugs su shar/ /dpal chen ye shes skur gsal ba/ /thig le chen po ye shes sku/ /sems nyid ma bcos rang byung gi /'bras bu sangs rgyas thob par shog /ces pas bstod de/ de nas 'dzab bzlas pa ni/ snying kha'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs rang la thim par bsam zhing / hūm̐ dpal chen thugs kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /ye shes tshon gang rin po che/ /thugs kyi snying po 'bru brgyad 'phros/ /'od zer gsal bar kun la khyab/ /oṃ ni 'bar ba'i seng ge brjid/ /ma tshogs sprin dang skar ltar 'phro/ /hūm̐ chen nyi zla'i tshogs rgyun 'dra/ /ma nor re skong mkha' la 'gro/ /oṃ ni ye shes lnga dang ldan/ /ru ni 'bar srog chags sdang 'joms/ /lu ni kun bzang bde ba'i yum/ /hūm̐ ni ye shes tshad med bzhi/ /bhyo ni gnas gyur ma 'gags pa/ /hūm̐ gis byin rlabs sdud par byed/ /ru lu 'di ltar ya mtshan che/ /ru lu rtogs pa gang du 'phel/ /ru lu dngos grub ma lus ster/ /oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐/ zhes yab kyi snying po dang / oṃ badzra kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐/ zhes pas yum gyi snying po ci rigs par bzla'o/ /de yang rdo rje phur pa'i bsnyen pa byed pa'i tshe/ oṃ ni dpal chen yab yin te/ /badzra shes rab yum du brjod/ /kī li dang po khro bo bcu/ /kī li gnyis pa khro mo bcu/ /zhes kī la ya kho na la gtso 'khor thams cad tshang bar gsungs pas/

bsnyen pa dang sbyin sreg bum pa 'bul ba sogs kyi sngags thams cad kī la ya kho nas go chod mdzad pa bzhin du 'dir yang mtshungs te/ 'dzab bskul las/ ru ni 'bar srog chags sdang 'joms/ /lu ni kun bzang bde ba'i yum/ /hūm̐ ni ye shes tshad med bzhi/ /zhes gtso bo yab yum dang / lha mo brgyad shin tu gsal bar bstan pas na/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rjes yang dag zla gam gcig pa'i sgrub thabs nor bu'i phreng ba las/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po gsung tshar ba'i rjes su/ bsnyen pa'i tshad ni 'bum phrag bcu'o/ /zhes gsungs nas yum la bcu cha bzla dgos pa sogs ma gsungs shing / sngags 'chang chen po'i rim pa gsal ba las/ zla gam dgu pa'i dbang du mdzad de/ gtso bo la 'bum phrag bcu bzlas na/ yum dang 'khor rnams la bcu cha bzla dgos par gsungs pa yang / rgyas pa ltar na de ltar byas kyang 'gal ba med mod/ mdor bsdus shing snying po tshang la nyams len bde ba ni zla gam gcig pa'i lugs 'di kho na yin no/ /gang ltar thun re la ru lu khri stong la sogs pa ci 'grub bzlas pa'i mthar yum gyi snying po gsum sogs bzlas la thun bsdu ba na phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bcug la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bcom ldan 'das dpal chen he ru ka'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang / tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas nas/ byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag bskyed la phyi mchod sgeg phreng sogs gong bzhin dang / rang byung gdod nas dag pa yi/ /rtsa brgyad stong las sbyar ba'i sman/

/bzhes te kun tu dges mdzod la/ /'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta shrī ka pā la bandha ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes nang mchod dang / rdo rje phyag 'tshal ba'i stangs ka dang / dril bu shlau ka re'i mtshams su dkrol la/ hūm̐ bde gshegs sogs yab bstod dang rnam dag sogs yum bstod byas la snga thun dang srod thun gnyis la dkar bdud phur srung gi gtor ma rnams bsang sbyangs byin rlabs gong gi sman gtor bzhin la/ mes gtor ma'i snod reg pas mi gtsang ba bsregs/ zhes dang / 'og gi gtor ma dang 'dres pas gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa zhes bsgyur/ 'bru gsum lan gsum/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su padma nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du/ bhyoḥ dkar po yongs su gyur pa las dkar mo nyi zla stong gi thod pa'i phreng ba can/ sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas pas ri rab sgang rdor 'phen zhing / g.yon pas gling bzhi 'byor stabs su mdzad pa/ nyi zla brgya yis dbu la brgyan cing / nyi zla dgu brgyas do shal byas pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang / dar dkar po'i na bza' can/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ de'i g.yon du rta nag po'i steng du hūm̐ las bdud kyi rgyal po thod pa'i phreng ba can sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ phyag g.yas pas ba dan nag po nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon pas rus phreng 'phyar thabs su 'dzin pa/ dar nag gi na bza' can/ mi mgo'i phreng ba dang / sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ 'khor 'chi bdag nag po rang dang 'dra ba brgyad kyis bskor ba/ gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dkar mo nyi zla dang /

bdud kyi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐ che ba'i che mchog gsang ba'i gzugs/ /thig le sbyor ba'i yum gcig ma/ /dkar mo nyi zla'i thod phreng can/ /srog bdag bdud kyi rgyal po yang / /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ e hye hi sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ padma ka ma lā ya satwaṃ/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpa' re re'i dbur brgyan/ de nas rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ badzra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ badzra sa ma ya hoḥ dkar mo nyi zla bdud rgyal thod phreng 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang / rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dam tshig srungs/ bstan pa skyongs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ khyad par du yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang / rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad tshar gcad pa dang / bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ badzra shāntiṃ padma kuntiṃ bhyoḥ oṃ sarba mā ra kṛṣṇa ka pā la ma la dha ra sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta bhuñdza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba sha trūn bighnān mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa gsum mam lngas gtor ma phul/ oṃ arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo ke gandhaṃ/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shapta āḥhūm̐/ shintaṃ ku ru/ wa shaṃ ku ru/ dkar mo nyi zla bdud rgyal thod pa'i phreng ba can 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /zhes pas nang mchod phul nas/

sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang / bla ma dam pa rnams kyi sku tshe dang mdzad pa phrin las kyi bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bsam don chos ldan yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de nas phur srung dam can bcu gnyis kyi gtor ma la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ lan gsum gyis byin rlabs dran par byas nas/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐ slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyi/ /spyan sngar phur pa'i srung mar zhal bzhes pa/ /bdag nyid chen mo shwa na bse mo'i tshogs/ /dpal gyi pho nya mthu rtsal rdzu 'phrul can/ /dam tshig dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya/ dha ti ma ma shrī ghraṃ karmā kā ra ma ra se na pra mardha ni sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ yang sa pa ri wā ra yan gyi rjes su/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta bhuñdza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sogs lan gsum mam lnga yis gtor ma phul la/ nang mchod gtor zhing / ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ ma hā rakta khā hi/ bdag nyid ma bzhi/ shwa na ma bzhi/ sa bdag ma bzhi/ phur srung dam can bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba sogs gong ltar brjod/ bhyoḥ dpal ldan dkar mo chen mo ni/ sngon tshe che mchog he ru ka'i/ /spyan sngar khas blangs de bzhin du/ /bdud dang mu stegs 'dul ba dang / /dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral ba dang / /sgrub po 'khor bcas bsrung ba dang / /bsam pa'i don rnams bsgrub pa dang / /bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /hūm̐/ sngon tshe bdud kun gyis ni bdag po che/ /shin tu mi bzad rdo rje khrag 'thung gi /spyan sngar dam bcas bdud rgyal thod phreng can/ /mthu rtsal rmad byung nag po che la bstod/ /hūm̐/ slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyi/ /spyan sngar phur pa'i srung mar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /bdag nyid chen mo shwa na bse mo'i tshogs/

/dpal gyi pho nya mthu rtsal rdzu 'phrul can/ /dam can ma mo sde gsum mchod bcu gnyis/ /rnam lnga rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /ma sring mdza' mo'i tshul gyis grogs mdzod cig /thugs dam rjes dgongs bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /dngos grub blang ba ni/ ye shes lnga ldan rigs lnga bde bar gshegs/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi/ /'khor lo rab bskor zhi khro'i skur ston pa/ /thugs dam dbang gis bdag la brtser dgongs nas/ /drag po'i stobs kyis dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskangs/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang / med na gshegs gsol byas te/ bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i 'bras bu ni/ phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub stsol/ /bcad gtub lus la mi 'byung zhing / /gzi mdangs nyi 'od bzhin du shog /oṃ badzra ka wa rtse hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bsrungs la/ rang gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wākka tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ dge ba 'di yis mtha' yas sems can kun/ /bdud las rnam rgyal bar chad kun bcom nas/ /khrag 'thung rgyal po he ru ka dpal gyi/ /'bras bu byang chub nges par 'grub gyur cig /ces pas bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas btab la/ shis pa brjod pa ni/ skye med chos sku'i rang bzhin rnam dag las/ /thugs dam dbang gis gzugs kyi sku sprul pa/ /bcom ldan he ru ka dpal yab yum gyi/ /skye shi med pa don gyi bkra shis shog /dgong thun la ni gzhan 'dra ba las/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje yab sras kyi phyag len ltar na gtor bsngo chen mo dang bskang ba dril gsil la sogs byed tshe/ de'i tshul sngags 'chang chen po'i gsung rab logs su gsal ba ltar bya zhing dkar bdud phur srung rnams kyang de'i khongs su 'dus pa yin no/

/de ltar zla ba gcig la thun gsum gyi sbyor bas ru lu 'bum phrag bcu kha skong dang bcas pa song ba dang mtshams grol ba'i nyin tshogs lhag ma bstan skyong rnams bya tshul ni/ ci 'byor pa'i tshogs phyag len bzhin bshams pa nang mchod kyis sbyangs la/ oṃ dra byaṃ bi shwa dha na raṃ yaṃ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes byin gyis brlabs nas/ spyan drangs ba ni/ hūm̐ zhi khro rab 'byams lha tshogs dang / /ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas rnams/ /kun bzang mchod sprin tshogs 'bul gyi/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badzra sa ma ya hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs nas/ dang po mchod pa ni/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer 'phro/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis brgyan/ /thugs dam bzhin du bzhes su gsol/ /dam tshig sgrub pa'i rdzas mchog 'di/ /bdag dang mnyam pa'i tshogs la 'bul/ /longs spyod lnga ldan thams cad ni/ /chos nyid ngang la chos nyid rol/ /a la la ho/ bzhes su gsol rol du gsol/ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ zhes brjod cing tshogs phud gtor ma la phul/ bar pa bshags pa ni/ lus ngag yid kyi sdig pa rnams/ /gti mug dbang gis byas pa dag /'gyod pa'i sems dang bcas pa yis/ /lha tshogs khyed la mthol lo bshags/ /de nas tha ma bsgral ba'i mchod pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa'i mdun du/ liṅga phyag len bzhin bshams pa gu gul gyis bdug nas bzhag de dang nye bar phur pa dang / ral gri yang 'dus byas shing / rang nyid rdo rje dril bu snying khar 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgyas bzung la/ ngag tu/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi bka' bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang / 'jam dpal sku/ padma gsung / yang dag thugs/ bdud rtsi yon tan/ phrin las phur bu/ ma mo rbod gtong / dmod pa drag sngags/

'jig rten mchod bstod/ 'dus pa mdo/ sgyu 'phrul rgyan/ 'chi med tshe/ lhun grub rig 'dzin/ snying po phyag rgya/ gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / bka' sdod chos skyong / ma mo mkha' 'gro/ dam can rgya mtsho/ rig 'dzin rnal 'byor/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang / bden pa yang dag dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlabs kyis/ spyir bstan pa'i spyi dgra/ bla ma'i sku dgra/ dam tshig can gyi sdang dgra/ sems can yongs la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa dang / khyad par du yang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod grogs mched 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gzugs can gyi dgra/ gzugs med kyi bgegs gang yin pa de dag thams cad skad cig thang cig yud tsam la mtshan ma rdzas kyi liṅga 'di nyid la mchis par gyur cig oṃ raṃ dzwa la raṃ hūm̐/ he he phaṭa/ kro dha da la maṇḍa la phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod cing dril bu gsil/ sgo ma bzhi'i phyag rgyas bkug cing bstim pas liṅga de dgra bgegs dngos su bsams la/ de'i snying dkar nag gi mtshams su phur bus btab pas/ kho'i rnam shes mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skyes par bsgom/ kho'i tshe lhag ma rang la thim pas rang nyid tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin du gyur par bsams la/ liṅga'i rnam smin gyi lus ral gris dum bur gtubs shing / oṃ gha gha/ ghā ta ya/ ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣṭan/ badzra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba sha trūn bighnān mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing bsgral ba'i ling ro de 'dod yon lngar bsams nas/ lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du phul ba'i mos pa dang ldan pas/ bla ma la ni brnyas byed dang / /dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs/ /dam tshig gnyan po bral byed pa/ /gnod byed ma lus zhal du bstab/ /badzra yakṣa kro dha khā hi/ zhes brjod la ling ro gtor ma la phul bas lha thams cad mnyes te/

ha ha zhes bzhad/ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes bdag la dngos grub stsal/ phaṭa phaṭa kyis dgra bgegs chos nyid du gnas spar bar bsam/ de nas mchod g.yog pas tshogs khyer la/ ho bdag cag rdo rje slob dpon dang / /mched dang lcam dral ma lus pa/ /zhal zas tshogs la rol pa yis/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /a la la ho/ zhes brjod cing tshogs la rol/ de nas lhag ma rnams bsdus la/ lhag ma za ba'i bye brag pho nya/ phra men ma/ 'bar ma/ dbang phyug ma/ ma bdun/ sring bzhi la sogs pa pho nya sum brgya drug cu rnams blos bkug la mchod par bsam zhing / oṃ badzra ḍā ki nī pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐/ oṃ buddha ḍā ki nī pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ oṃ/ oṃ ratna ḍā ki nī pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ traṃ/ oṃ padma ḍā ki nī pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ hrīḥ oṃ karma ḍā ki nī pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ ā/ zhes pas gtso mo brgyad la gtor ma byin la/ oṃ u tsiṣṭa ba liṃ ta bhakṣa si swāhā/ zhes brjod cing lhag ma la chang gi kha phru btab nas/ sarba ā na ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ta thā ya ta thā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas lhag ma btang zhing phyi rol tu dor ro/ /de nas bstan ma skyong ba ni/ sgrub khang gi steng ngam gnas de nyid du/ rdo rje'i khyung gshog gi phyag rgya bcas la/ ho bod khams skyong bar byed pa'i bstan ma bcu gnyis/ dpal chen po'i pham 'bags la gnas te rnal 'byor pa'i sdong dang grogs la nag mo bzhin mi sdug gi bu mo bdud mo chen mo bzhi/ dmar mo khro gnyer can gyi bu mo gnod sbyin ma chen mo bzhi/ dkar sham bzhin bzang gi bu mo sman btsun ma chen mo bzhi rnams sngon gyi thugs dam las ma 'da' bar 'dir gshegs shig dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ḍā ki nī hūm̐ dzaḥ e a ra li hriṃ hriṃ/ zhes brjod cing bkug la gong du bcas pa'i phyag rgyas zil gyis mnan te/ bhyoḥ bka' yi bran g.yog tshogs dang bcas nyid du/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung de bzhin nam mkha'i sku/

/tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bstan ma skyong ba rnams/ /sngon gyi thugs dam dam tshig rjes dgongs te/ /'dir gshegs dam dgongs mchod sbyin gtor ma bzhes/ /rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /ces brjod nas sman raka dang / gtor ma rnams khang steng du phul la/ ya hi gatstsha/ zhes pas bstan ma gshegs su gsol/ dngos grub blang ba man ni gong ltar bya zhing / 'on kyang bla ma yi dam chos srung nor lha sogs kyi bkra shis gang shes byas la mtshams tho bsdus rim gyis gnas gzhan du 'gro ba dang mi dang 'phrad pa sogs bya ba las dus gcig la thug mi rung ba bsnyen pa'i yi ge mang po las bshad do/ /de ltar mtshams yongs rdzogs zin nas nus pa dbyung ba'i phyir sbyin sreg bya ba'am/ yang na bzlas grangs them nas mtshams khang de nyid du sbyin sreg bya ba la don gsum ste/ sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes kyi cho ga'o/ /dang po ni/ sbyor ba thab dang bud shing sbar ba me/ /rdzas dang bsham thabs sgrub pa po ste drug /ces pa ltar las/ dang po thab ni nyams dga' zhing sa'i cho ga byas pa'i sa phyogs su thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab pa la/ khru phyed kyi dbus nas zlum por bskor ba ni thab kyi dngos gzhi dang / de'i phyi rol tu sor bzhi bskor ba kha khyer dang / slar yang sor bzhi bskor ba mu ran dang / tshad de nyid kyis tshangs thig dang mu ran 'dzoms pa'i sa nas zur thig bzhi'i steng du mtshan pa byas pa la/ thig bzhi legs par sbrel ba'i steng du gru bzhi dang / de'i grwa bzhir rdo rje'i rtse nang ngos su bstan pa'i zla phyed rdo rje bya/ phyag len la stegs bu gru bzhi ba'i phyi rol tu'ang sor bzhi'i tshad kyi cho ga gru bzhi mdzad pa ni bris cha la mig sngar mdzes pa dang / bsgom don la stegs bu'i dpyangs kyi tshad yin gsungs/ thab kyi dbus nas sum gnyis phyir bzhag pa'i nang gi sum cha zlum por bskor ba'i dbus su zla gam sgo gcig pa rang la bstan pa dang /

phyogs mtshams brgyad du zla gam sgo gcig pa rnams dbus la bstan pa re re ste dgu bris/ de yang thab kyi gzhi thams cad kha dog dkar por bya/ kha khyer ram mu ran gang rung la rdo rje kha zlum pa'i phreng bas bskor ba/ kha dog 'dres pa'i skyon spangs pa'i phyir bcad tshon thams cad dang rdo rje kha dog dmar skya bya/ lha'i gnas rnams su me tog gi tshom bu'am/ so so'i sku mdog dang bstun pa'i tshom phung bya/ rgyas par na thab kyi kha dog gong bzhin la/ zla gam rnams gzhi dmar skya bcad dkar po/ nang du padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la dbus su rdo rje sngon po/ phyogs mtshams su lha mo rnams kyi g.yas pa'i phyag mtshan rang rang gi sku mdog dang mthun par bya ba ste/ gtso bo'i zhal nub bstan du 'byung bas/ 'jig rten pa'i nub rang gi shar gyi zla gam de la gau rī mtshan ma bkod pas phyogs mtshams gzhan rnams kyang shes par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa bud shing ni/ tsher ma can ma yin pa'i shing ngam/ de med na srog chags med pa'i lci bas thab kyi kha khyer gyi steng nas zlum por brtsigs pa la nang gi shar lho'i mtshams su ting lo che ba gcig kyang bshams la bzhag go /gsum pa sbar ba'i me ni/ rdo dang lcags gtsub pa las byung ba ma yin pa rgyun bzhag gi me'am/ 'o ma can gtsub pa sogs las byung ba'o/ /bzhi ba rdzas ni/ bsreg rdzas dang / mchod rdzas dang / gtor ma dang / ku sha'i chun po la sogs pa 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams gtsang zhing gya nom pa sta gon bya'o/ /lnga pa bsham thabs ni/ thab kyi mtha' skor thams cad byi dor legs par byas la dri bzang pos byugs/ de'i mdun du rang gi stan nang tshang can kha dog dkar po bya/ rang gi g.yon thab kyi g.yas nas chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang gtor ma gsum mam ji ltar 'byor pa bshams/ rang gi g.yas thab kyi g.yon nas/ /yam shing mar til zas mchog dang / /so ba 'bras nas gro dang ni/

/sran ma dur ba ku sha rnams/ /phyag len ji bzhin legs par bshams/ /rang gi mdun du bsang chu'i snod/ ku sha'i 'thor yab/ rdo rje dril bu/ ḍā ma ru/ 'thor nas/ nang gi mchod pa rnams bshams/ rdo rje dril bu'i bar du dgang gzar blugs gzar kha sbyar la bzhag so sor bzhag na bar chad kyi chos yin gsungs/ grub na thab dang sgrub po'i bar du 'jim pa las byas pa'i me yol dkar zhal gyis byugs pa'ang bshams la/ rdzas thams cad la bdud rtsi lngas gtor ma bzhag go /drug pa sgrub pa po ni/ phyi red kyi dus su rang nyid khrus byas/ 'byor na gos rgyan dkar pos brgyan la sdig pa dang bar chad zhi bar 'dod pa'i bsam pas sngar bshams pa'i stan la kha shar du bstan la skyil krung ngam pus 'khyud bcas tsog pu rkang pa gnyis cung zad bsnol ba rigs byed 'don pa lta bus spyod lam gyis 'dug go /dngos gzhi la/ bdag gi rnal 'byor me btsal yo byad bsang / /thab khung 'dus byas 'jig rten me lha mchod/ /'das pa'i me lha mchod rnams dngos gzhi'i chos/ /zhes pa ltar drug las/ dang po bdag gi rnal 'byor ni/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas/ tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol gyi bar gong bzhin bdag bskyed byas la/ 'di nas brtsams te sbyin sreg gi cho ga ma grub bar la lag pa gnyis pus mo las phyir mi 'da' ba la bslab bo/ /gnyis pa me btsal zhing sgrub pa ni/ skabs 'dir ting nge 'dzin gyi me sbar zhing shin tu 'bar bar bsams/ gsum pa thab dang yo byad bsang ba ni/ bsang chu la nang mchod rdo rje'i rtses gtor nas/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li hūm̐ tshindha tshindha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swā bhā wa shuddha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las shaṃ las byung ba'i dung phor mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i nang du hūm̐ las byung ba'i bsang chu dwangs shing thogs pa med pa thab dang yo byad thams cad kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/

oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta sogs 'khyil pa'i sngags nyer gcig bzla/ de nas thab dang yo byad rnams la ku sha'i 'thor yab kyis bsang chu gtor nas 'khyil pa'i sngags dang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ las lha rdzas kyi mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu dang / bsreg rdzas rnams kyang gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba zhi ba'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ badzra a ha ra li hūm̐ nas/ bi pu ra ya hūm̐ gi bar dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ yaṃ shing / oṃ shrī swāhā/ mar/ oṃ dzriṃ swāhā/ 'bru/ oṃ oṃ swāhā/ rdzas thams cad bkru/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ rdzas thams cad sbyangs/ bzhi pa thab khung mngon par 'du bya ba ni/ yang thab la bsang chu gtor nas/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇṭa li hūm̐ tshindha sogs dang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po/ rgyar khru gang / zabs su khru phyed kha khyer dang mu ran la rdo rjes mtshan zhing / phyi rol stegs bu gru bzhi'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes brgyan pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa bud shing brtsegs pa dang bcas par gyur par bsam/ lnga pa 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ de'i dbus su padma dang nyi ma'i steng du raṃ la bgrang phreng raṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcis tu gyur pa las me lha sku mdog dmar po 'od zer dkar po 'phro zhing 'du ba ra skyes la zhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas bgrang phreng dang / g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ gsus khyim che ba/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang / sma ra'i ag tshom can/

drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros te shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang / lag pa gnyis kyi mthe bong gung mo'i rtsa bar bzhag mdzub mo gung mo'i rgyab nas bkab pa dbyug gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing / oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol/ /gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po/ /thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa/ /'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ agni ye ma hā te dza sarba karma pra sa dha ka ma hā bhu ta de wa ṛ ṣi/ de wi dzaḥsatwa/ ma gṛ hi twa/ sarba satwārtha kri twa āḥhūm̐ ti asmi sanni hi twa bha wa padma ka ma lā ya satwaṃ/ oṃ agni ye sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas shapta āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā bhu ta dzwa la ya sarba duṣṭan bhasmin ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ tri shya hoḥdza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥs ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes dam la bzhag oṃ badzra yakṣi ni hūm̐ dzaḥ sogs kyi dgug gzhug bya/ slar yang rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad la bsang chu gtor nas/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa 'bag pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/

/tshangs pa yi ni dag byed yin/ /'dis bdag cag gi bgegs dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs zhi zhing las kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ oṃ badzra satwa āḥ zhes pas ku sha'i rtse mo g.yas skor du thab kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du dbul/ de nas sbyin sreg gi gzhung rnams su gong du me sbar ba bshad kyang spor lde sbar nas thab la g.yas su lan gsum bskor zhing kī la ya brjod/ oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ/ zhes pas thab kyi nang gi ting lo la sbar zhing / de nas yam shing gzhan dang bcas me legs par 'bar du bcug cing / mar dgang blugs gsum dang dzwa la'i sngags kyis gso/ de nas/ me lha'i lce hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang / dgang blugs kyi kha la raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ oṃ agni ye swāhā/ oṃ agni ye dī bya bi shuddhe mahā shri ye ha bya ka bya ba ha na ya/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chags sngags kyi lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis byon zan dbul/ dgang blugs kha sbyar ma thab la lan gsum bskor zhing / oṃ agni ye sa pa ri wā ra argha āḥhūm̐/ pā dyaṃ nas/ shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ nang mchod mtheb srin gyis gtor la/ oṃ agni ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur bas/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsregs/ /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ces pas bstod/ skabs 'dir me'i pra brtag pa ni/ saṃ bu ṭa las 'byung ba'i don kun mkhyen rin po che bsod nams seng ges/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rdo rje dang / /bum pa padma lcags kyu dang / /ku 'dum pa dang g.yas su 'khyil/ /rtse gcig pa de dbyibs mchog yin/ /rtse gnyis rtse gsum 'bring dang mtha'/ /snum dang gtsang dang 'ja' tshon dang / /dbang po sbas pa ser dang dkar/ /baiḍūrya rnams mdog bzang yin/

/dwangs pa'i sku dang bung ba'i sgra/ /zab cing snyan pa'i sgra ni bzang / /mdor na yid du 'ong ba yi/ /dbyibs dang dri dang sgra rnams bzang / /me stag rnam 'phro du ba mang / /rim gyis 'bar zhing me lce chad/ /myur tu 'bar zhing gzi brjid chung / /tsha zhing dmar nag drag tu 'bar/ /rtse gsum zhib ma 'dra ba dang / /ba lang mgo 'dra dri mi zhim/ /mdor na yid du mi 'ong ba/ /mtshan ngan rnams kyang brtag par bya/ /zhi la dkar la rgyas la ser/ /dbang la dmar la drag la nag /'di ni rang rang rtags su bzang / /'jam po gsum la 'jam po yi/ /rtags rnams shis par bshad pa ste/ /mtha' ma'i las la ngan pa bsngags/ /rang rang rtags dang mi mthun na/ /bgegs dang bcas pa shes bya ste/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la sogs pa'i/ /khro bo'i bgegs rnams zhi bar bya/ /mdor bsdu na kha dog dkar zhing snum pa sgra cung zad dang bcas pa du ba chung ba zhi ba'i las la dge'o/ /du ba che ba me stag rab tu 'phro ba ni bgegs dang bcas pa yin pas hūm̐ zhes brjod cing bsang chu phyogs kun tu gtor te bgegs zhi bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bsreg rdzas dbul ba ni/ thog mar yam shing byang chub kyi shing du mos te/ oṃ bho dhi bṛkṣa ya swāhā/ zhes pa bdun gyis phul ba'i mthar/ oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣa ye/ bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dang / gsang sngags kyi lhag chad la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes brjod/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la yang de'i rigs pas shes par byas la/ oṃ agni ye swāhā/ zhes pas mar dang / oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ye swāhā/ zhes pas til lam yungs dkar dang / oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swāhā/ zhes zho dang sbyar ba'i zas mchog dang / oṃ badzra bi dza ye swāhā/ 'bras so ba can dang / oṃ badzra puṣṭa ye swāhā/ 'bras dang / oṃ ma hā be gā ya swāhā/

nas dang / oṃ badzra ghasma ra ye swāhā/ gro dang / oṃ ma hā ba la ye swāhā/ sran ma dang / oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swāhā/ dur ba dang / oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzra ye swāhā/ ku sha rnams phul la/ sde tshan re re'i mthar gong ltar gyi spel tshig sbyor/ de nas bsang chu nas me nang du cung zad blugs la/ oṃ prokṣa nam añtsa ma naṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ zhes pas bsang gtor dang zhabs bsil phul/ mar blugs gzar gang thab nang du blugs la/ oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur pa bsam/ drug pa 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ slar me gso ba'i phyir bud shing brtsigs pa dang / mchod pa bsreg rdzas rnams kha cung zad gsos la/ 'khyil pa'i sngags dang / oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ oṃ dharma dhā tu badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ sogs kyis me dang thab bsangs sbyangs/ hūm̐ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ hūm̐ las raṃ chad snod bcud kyi 'jig rten bsregs/ yaṃ spros pas rlung gis gtor/ khaṃ spros pas chus bkrus/ skyon thams cad dag par byas/ e yaṃ baṃ raṃ laṃ raṃ keṃ bhrūṃ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ hūm̐ las yi ge de dag spros pas rten gyi dkyil 'khor du/ /e las mkha' dbyings dag pa nam mkha'i dkyil/ /yaṃ las rlung chen rgya gram sra zhing brtan/ /de steng baṃ las byung ba'i chu dkyil dkar/ /raṃ las me byung bskyod pa de yi phyed/ /laṃ las sa yi dkyil 'khor brtan par gyur/ /de steng rakta'i rgyal mtsho rba rlabs 'khrug /dbus su keng rus ri rab brtsegs pa'i steng / /bhrūṃ las rin chen lnga yi rang bzhin las/ /legs grub dwangs shing thogs med gzhal yas khang / /phyogs bzhi shel gser byu ru margad mdog /lte ba baiḍūrya yi rang bzhin can/ /steng logs rtsig pa ka ba gdung la sogs/ /kun kyang rin chen lnga las legs grub cing / /'khor lo rin chen pad ral rdo rjes mtshan/ /rgya phub rtse mor rdo rje nor bu'i tog

/sgo bzhi rin chen sna bzhi'i rang bzhin las/ /rab mdzes rta babs bzhi yis rnam par brgyan/ /steng gi kha khyer rin chen du mas spras/ /bya 'dab mas dpyangs gser gyi skud pas brgyus/ /rnga yab zla ba rdo rje phyed pa dang / /dar dpyangs sogs kyis brgyan pa'i do shal dang / /do shal phyed pas khor yug kun tu spras/ /steng du mda' yab padma phyed pa'i dbyibs/ /thur du rin chen shar bu'i rnam par mdzes/ /'og gi stegs bur gzugs mas me long thogs/ /sgra mas gling bu dri mas dung chos thogs/ /re mos zhal zas reg mas na bza' dang / /dbyings mas chos 'byung sgeg mos rdo rje dang / /phreng mas phreng ba glu mas pi waṃ bsnams/ /gar mas rdo rje me tog me tog snod/ /spos mas spos dang mar mes sgron me'i snod/ /rdza rnga rdza rnga chen mo'i rdza rngas mchod/ /gzhal yas dbus su bde chen byang chub sems/ /dkar dmar mdog can zla gam sgo gcig pa/ /dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad du re re ste/ /phyi rol dur khrod phyogs skyong zhing skyong klu/ /shing me mchod rten chu bo grub pa brgyad/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin srin po dang / /sha za smyo byed brjed byed ro langs dang / /mdung dang gsal shing rtse yis phug pa'i ro/ /ro dum thod tshal sha khrag rus pas dkrigs/ /wa dang lce spyang khra 'ug bya rgod dang / /kaṃ ka la sogs phaiṃ sgra sgrogs pa gang / /dzaḥs padma maṇḍal la/ mā sūrya maṇḍa la/ a tsaṇḍa maṇḍa la/ ma hā de wa dzaḥ u ma de wī dzaḥ ma traṃ dzaḥ lan brgyad/ padma nyi ma zla ba drag po pho mo'i gdan/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du padma nyi ma ro'i gdan re re/ gdan de rnams kyi steng du dbus su hūm̐/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du gaṃ tsaṃ praṃ baṃ paṃ ghaṃ shaṃ tsaṃ/ sa bon de rnams las 'od 'phros 'dus don gnyis byas/ yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su dpal chen khro bo'i rgyal/ /zhes pa nas/ ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs/

/zhes pa'i bar dang / yum chen khro mo dbang phyug sngo nas/ yab kyi g.yon nas 'khyud par bzhugs/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi gtso bo yab yum bskyed/ shar du lha mo gau rī sngo/ /g.yas na dbyug pa g.yon bandha/ /lho ru lha mo tsau rī ser/ /phyag gnyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa'i tshul/ /nub tu lha mo pra mo ha/ /dmar mo rgyal mtshan thod khrag 'dzin/ /byang du lha mo betta lī/ /ljang nag rdo rje byis ro za/ /shar lhor lha mo pukka sī/ /dmar ser phyag gnyis rgyu zhags 'dren/ /srin por lha mo ghasma rī/ /ljang khu rdo rje thod khrag 'dzin/ /rlung du lha mo dur khrod ma/ /mthing nag dpag bsam mi snying bsnams/ /byang shar lha mo tsaṇḍa lī/ /ser skya rtse gsum ro 'dzin pa/ /kun kyang dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/ /g.yon brkyang me phung dbus na bzhugs/ /lha de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas he ru ka lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor badzra sa mā dzaḥ spro na spos dang bcas pas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa yi/ /chos sku nam mkha' lta bur dbyer med kyang / /thabs dang shes rab gzugs brnyan skur ston pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /zhes dang / ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon mgon gyur cing / /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gi mthar/ oṃ badzra yakṣi ni hūm̐ dzaḥsogs/ gnyis su med par thim/ yang 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha khro bo rigs lnga badzra sa mā dzaḥ thabs kyi spyod pa sogs sngags dang bcas pas dbang bskur/ gtso 'khor thams cad la khro bo rigs lnga re re dbu brgyan/ de nas byon zan 'bul ba ni/ ru lu lan gsum gyi mthar/ oṃ agni ye zhes sogs spel tshig dang bcas pa gong me lha bzhin phul/ slar yang mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas rnams gong bzhin byin brlabs sgeg phreng sogs kyis phyi mchod/

rang byung gdod nas dag pa sogs dang / rgyal ba kun dngos sogs kyis nang mchod/ rtog med spros bral sogs de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa dang / rmad du byung ba'i sogs gtor ma rakta dmar gyi sogs rakta'i mchod pa/ hūm̐ bde gshegs mnyam nyid nas/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas thob par shog gi bar bstod pa bdag bskyed bzhin byas la/ de nas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba'i go rim ni gong bzhin la/ sngags rnams ru lu 'ba' zhig gis 'bul/ bsnyen pa kha gso'i skabs su til lam yungs dkar gang rung la grangs 'dzin pa ste/ cho ga gcig la 'bul tshan bcu gcig yod pa'i bcu la ru lu stong phrag re bzlas pas khri tshang bar 'gyur ro/ /skabs skabs su me gso ba'i phyir yam shing dang mar ji ltar rig pa 'bul/ bsregs rdzas gzhan rnams brgya rtsa re 'bul dgos par dus gcig la phul na me mi 'bar ba'i skyon yong bas skabs su gang babs re 'bul/ mthar mar gyis gang ba'i sbyin sreg lan bdun spel tshig gong ltar bya/ de nas phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ bstod pa'i mchod pa rnams gong bsnyen pa'i skabs kyi bzlas pa'i mjug bzhin la/ lha mo rnams kyi bstod pa man sbyin sreg 'dir bshad pa ltar byas la/ gtor bsngo chen mo'am dkar bdud phur srung rnams kyi gtor bsngo/ tshogs nas bstan skyong gi bar byed par spro na gong bzhin/ ye shes lnga ldan sogs/ dngos grub blang ba yig brgya gsum/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs bzod gsol/ sku thang sogs yod na phyogs bcu na sogs brtan bzhugs/ rten med pa'i ye shes pa dang thab nang gi ye shes pa la dmigs nas/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad sogs kyis thab kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis thal ba blangs la dpral bar reg go /gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga ni/ me lha lhag mas mchod dang gtor ma btang / 'dod don zhus la gshegs gsol lhag chad bskang /

las kyi rjes bsdu ba ste drug yin no/ /zhes pa ltar las/ dang po me lha mchod pa ni/ thab khung du mar blugs gzar gang dgang gzar la reg pa dang bcas pas/ oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ zhes brjod la/ me lha zhal gcig phyag gnyis dwangs shing thogs pa med pa'i sku can du gyur par bsam/ de nas bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams so so'i spel tshig dang bcas pa bdun re 'bul/ slar yang mar gyis gang ba'i sbyin sreg lan bdun phul la/ mchod bstod gong bzhin bya/ gnyis pa gtor ma btang ba ni/ me lha 'khor bcas kyi gtor ma nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ agni ye sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ oṃ agni ye sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro ba'i phyi mchod/ nang mchod gong bzhin dang / bstod pa ni/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs kyi mthar/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i dbang gi skur ston pa/ /rigs sngags grub pa'i drang srong tshul/ /nyon mongs bsreg pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyis sprul pa'i theg pa chibs/ /rig sngags gsung gi bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan ghundhe bsnams/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che/ /de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhes bstod/ gsum pa 'dod don zhu ba ni/ drang srong chen po 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnams la/

/rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pa'i bar gyis 'dod don gsol ba'o/ /bzhi pa gshegs su gsol ba ni/ oṃ prokṣa naṃ añtsa ma naṃ pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ bsang gtor dang zhabs bsil phul/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /byin za khyod kyis sgrub kyin gshegs/ /ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te/ /bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs/ /oṃ agni ye ya hi gatstsha/ zhes dang / dbyug gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed do/ /me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo/ /lnga pa lhag chad kha bskang ba ni/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang / oṃ shrī badzra ku ma ra sogs kyis go cha bgo ba dang bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rnams sgrub thabs bzhin bya'o/ /drug pa las kyi rjes bsdu ba ni/ de lta bu'i sbyin sreg gi dus 'dir me'i dkyil mi dkrugs/ phus mi gdab/ me ma shi bar g.yo 'gul mi byed/ bud shing dang yam shing sogs bsreg rdzas rnams la mi 'gom/ me lha drang srong yin pas gtsang sbra la gnas par bya'o/ /me yal ba dang thal ba rnams rang gis bsdus la chur sbyang ngo / /zhes dpal chen yang dag zla gam gcig pa'i bsnyen thabs dang dgu pa'i sbyin sreg 'di ni sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dpal sa skya'i chos grwa bde chen gling gi bca' yig brtsams pa'i tshe 'di bzhin sgrig par khas blangs pa de nyid mi 'dor ba'i phyir sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i rdo rje phur pa'i bsnyen sgrub gsal byed bdud rtsi'i 'od can dang / 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i de'i sbyin sreg phrin las lhun grub gnyis la yang dag gi khyad chos dang / chos srung gi gtor bsngo sogs sbyor dgos pa rnams sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' rin chen gnyis kyis mdzad pa'i yang dag sgrub dkyil dang /

dkar bdud phur srung gi gtor bsngo rnams nas kha bskang / phur pa'i bsnyen sgrub gsal byed du bdag bskyed la keng rus ri rab kyi steng chos 'byung gru gsum gyi nang du gtso bo yab yum las med pa la/ mdun du dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs spyan drangs mchod bstod rnams bdag mdun thun mong du mdzad pa rnams 'dir yang sbyar zhing / bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i bsnyen pa la sbyin sreg gi tshe phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor sogs mdzad 'dug pa bzhin/ zla gam gcig pa'i bsnyen pa la zla gam dgu pa'i sbyin sreg byed pa rigs 'gre sbyar ba yin pas don la rang bzo'i dri ma cung zad kyang med cing / yang sgrub thabs kyi skabs su bdud rtsi 'bul tshig nged rang nas rgyas su btang ba 'dir yang mkhas grub tshad ldan rnams kyis thugs gzu bo'i gzigs pas skyon med du 'gyur ba 'di bzhin du bsgrigs shing / skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gong sa lnga pa chen pos sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen la lugs 'di las brtsams pa'i bka' skyon du ma phebs 'dug pa rnams la dgongs bsangs gsad dkrol gyi yi ge zhig logs su 'chad par bdag spro ba bcas me khyi lor sbyar ba 'di'i dge bas sems can thams cad gnas skabs su mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal zhing mthar thug dpal he ru ka'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 30 kun dga' blo gros/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor yang dag zla gam gcig pa dang dgu pa'i bsnyen sgrub sbyin sreg PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 29
